About Us

About Quran Light Institute

Quran Light Institute is an online Quran academy helping children and adults around the world learn the Holy Quran from the comfort of home. With 5+ years of teaching experience, our qualified and caring male & female teachers give every student their full, personal attention in live one-to-one classes.

From a child's very first Noorani Qaida lesson to advanced Tajweed, memorization and Tafseer, we follow a clear, step-by-step path — with regular progress monitoring so parents always know how their child is doing.
